newsitem.title: UK: Heron buys London building from Lloyds. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Heron buys London building from Lloyds. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]

text.p: Unlisted UK property company Heron International said on Thursday that it has bought an office building in London's financial district from Lloyds Bank for an 80 million stg development site.
(Corrects to make clear that Heron did not pay Lloyds 80 million stg for the site).
Heron did not disclose the price it paid Lloyds for the building.
The site has planning consent for a new 115,000 square foot scheme and construction will start early next year with completion due in 1999.
Heron has announced transactions valued at over 500 million stg in the last seven months.
Lloyds Bank is a unit of Lloyds TSB Group Plc.
